rationale: A decimal multiplier for conservative controller duration planning is a durable policy input. The established name is concise and unambiguous in this context; preserve it as an exact Decimal rather than a binary floating-point value.
alternatives: remove: would force an implicit, less auditable planning margin
rename to duration_headroom_factor: adds redundant context within controller_policy
simplestChoice: Keep headroom_factor as an exact Decimal controller-policy field.
